message.content:
I need to gather all issues (not pull requests) created in the cli/cli GitHub repository during December 2024 (2024-12-01 to 2024-12-31).

Use the `gh` CLI tool to do this.

I need to find:
1. Total issues created in Dec 2024
2. How many of those are bug reports (any issue where at least one label contains the substring "bug", case-insensitive - e.g., "bug", "type: bug", "kind/bug", etc.)
3. How many of those bug report issues were closed (state = closed) - checking their current state as of today

IMPORTANT: Issues only, not pull requests. The GitHub API sometimes returns PRs in issue searches, so filter them out (PRs have a `pull_request` field).

A good approach:
```
gh api --paginate "repos/cli/cli/issues?state=all&sort=created&direction=desc&per_page=100&since=2024-12-01T00:00:00Z" --jq '.[] | select(.pull_request == null) | select(.created_at >= "2024-12-01T00:00:00Z" and .created_at < "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z") | {number, state, created_at, labels: [.labels[].name]}'
```

Make sure to paginate to get ALL results.

At the end, print a clear summary with:
- total issues created in Dec 2024
- bug report count (issues with at least one label containing "bug" substring, case-insensitive)
- resolved (closed) bug count

Print the final summary in a clearly labeled format so I can parse it.

content.text: I'll gather all issues from the cli/cli repository created in December 2024. Let me run the paginated API call to get all the data.

input.command: gh api --paginate "repos/cli/cli/issues?state=all&sort=created&direction=desc&per_page=100&since=2024-12-01T00:00:00Z" --jq '.[] | select(.pull_request == null) | select(.created_at >= "2024-12-01T00:00:00Z" and .created_at < "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z") | {number, state, created_at, labels: [.labels[].name]}'
input.description: Fetch all issues (not PRs) created in cli/cli during December 2024 with pagination

input.command:
python3 << 'PYEOF'
import urllib.request
import json
import time

all_issues = []
page = 1
per_page = 100

while True:
    url = (
        f"https://api.github.com/search/issues?"
        f"q=repo:cli/cli+is:issue+created:2024-12-01..2024-12-31"
        f"&per_page={per_page}&page={page}"
    )
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"Accept": "application/vnd.github+json"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())

    items = data.get("items", [])
    total_count = data.get("total_count", 0)

    for item in items:
        # The search API for is:issue should not return PRs, but double-check
        if "pull_request" in item:
            continue
        labels = [l["name"] for l in item.get("labels", [])]
        all_issues.append({
            "number": item["number"],
            "state": item["state"],
            "created_at": item["created_at"],
            "labels": labels,
            "title": item["title"],
        })

    print(f"Page {page}: fetched {len(items)} items (total_count={total_count})")

    if len(items) < per_page or len(all_issues) >= total_count:
        break
    page += 1
    time.sleep(1)  # rate limit courtesy

print(f"\nTotal issues fetched (excluding PRs): {len(all_issues)}")
print()

# Identify bug reports: any label containing "bug" (case-insensitive)
bug_issues = []
for issue in all_issues:
    is_bug = any("bug" in label.lower() for label in issue["labels"])
    if is_bug:
        bug_issues.append(issue)

closed_bugs = [i for i in bug_issues if i["state"] == "closed"]

print("=" * 60)
print("ALL ISSUES CREATED IN DEC 2024:")
print("=" * 60)
for i in sorted(all_issues, key=lambda x: x["number"]):
    print(f"  #{i['number']} [{i['state']}] {i['title']}")
    if i["labels"]:
        print(f"    Labels: {', '.join(i['labels'])}")
print()

print("=" * 60)
print("BUG REPORT ISSUES:")
print("=" * 60)
for i in sorted(bug_issues, key=lambda x: x["number"]):
    bug_labels = [l for l in i["labels"] if "bug" in l.lower()]
    print(f"  #{i['number']} [{i['state']}] {i['title']}")
    print(f"    Bug label(s): {', '.join(bug_labels)} | All labels: {', '.join(i['labels'])}")
print()

print("=" * 60)
print("FINAL SUMMARY")
print("=" * 60)
print(f"Total issues created in Dec 2024: {len(all_issues)}")
print(f"Bug report count: {len(bug_issues)}")
print(f"Closed bug report count: {len(closed_bugs)}")
print("=" * 60)
PYEOF
